email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Global Communications Specialist role at Jobat, supporting an international automotive company. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content, I create clear, accessible communication across websites and social channels, and I'd bring that mix to your team.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I manage CMS content, write SEO-focused blog posts, and build and optimize websites in WordPress. I've also designed and maintained Shopify stores, handled social media integration, and used analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. My technical background helps me translate complex information into straightforward content, and I'm comfortable coordinating across teams and markets.

I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have Dutch writing skills at B1 level. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to a consistent brand identity across channels.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Global Communications Specialist role at Jobat, where you're seeking a Communication Officer for an international automotive company. Your focus on developing communication materials, managing social media, creating photo and video content, and coordinating website content across markets aligns closely with my experience in digital marketing, SEO and content.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites, write and publish SEO-focused blog posts, and build and optimize WordPress sites. I've worked on Shopify stores, handling store design, product catalogues and blog content, and I've integrated social media into client websites. My technical background in front-end development and my daily use of AI tools help me translate complex information into accessible communication and automate repetitive tasks.

I've also built and optimized websites like mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. This experience taught me the importance of a consistent brand identity across all channels, and I'm comfortable collaborating with marketing, sales and operations teams to uphold that consistency.

I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have Dutch writing skills at B1 level. I'm eager to bring my mix of content, web and analytical skills to your international team and help create communication that resonates across markets.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this role further.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
